entries.appliesTo: persons producing child sexual abuse materials, including AI-generated depictions of children

sources.prohibition: § 1, R.S. 14:81.1(B)(3) — '"child" includes both a natural person under the age of seventeen years and an image or other visual representation of a child under the age of seventeen years that is created or generated by electronic or digital means, including artificial intelligence'
sources.coveredSubjects: § 1, R.S. 14:81.1(B)(3) — 'any sexual performance involving a child under the age of seventeen'

flags: definitions-only amendment to existing criminal statute R.S. 14:81.1: expands 'child sexual abuse materials' and 'produce' ('cause to be digitally generated, including by artificial intelligence') to cover AI-generated content; the offense and penalty provisions of R.S. 14:81.1 are not restated in this text, so no exposure is coded
AI-generated image covered only if 'to a reasonable person, is a virtually indistinguishable depiction of a child under the age of seventeen years'
age threshold is seventeen, but ai-crimes family has no ageThreshold param — noted here per rule 5
